envelope.description: Embeddings protocol, errors and disk cache

body.title: Embeddings protocol, errors and disk cache
body.summary: Add the Embedder protocol and the EncoderFingerprint record in embeddings/protocol.py, EmbeddingBackendError, a disk cache wrapper keyed by fingerprint and text with atomic writes and read validation, and a deterministic fake embedder for tests. The fingerprint lives here because embeddings may import no other project package.
acceptanceChecks: The fingerprint holds model name, digest, quantization, backend name and version, dimension, text convention and dtype
Cache key changes when digest, dimension, text convention or text changes
A corrupt or truncated entry is discarded and encoded again
Entries are written through a temporary file and atomic rename
Empty or whitespace input raises ValueError
Duplicate inputs return identical rows in input order
embeddings imports no other project package

tests.name: cache key changes with digest, dimension, convention and text; corrupt entry recovery
empty input rejection and duplicate inputs in order
